svg.title: How a season gets its contract label, and how often the label is right
svg.text: 1. Read the signals for each season
last season of a deal, next not yet secured
Each dot is 1% of the seasons a reference
knows were contract years, colored by what the
98% of its contract-year labels were right
83% of its contract-year labels were right
81% of its contract-year labels were right
A wrong label puts a season in the other
group, which pulls the two groups' averages
together. Label errors shrink a real gap
toward zero; they rarely create one.
